findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_upload_url · Private data: get_upload_url · Public sink: get_upload_url.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_upload_url · Private data: get_upload_url · Public sink: get_upload_url

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "extract_vocals" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet:
before: "Extract the vocals from a song — a convenient shortcut for process_audio
    with task_type='2stems'. Returns two stems: the isolated vocals and the
    instrumental. Ideal for a cappella, karaoke, covers or vocal practice.

    Args:
        source_key: The source_key returned by upload_audio or ge" → after: "Extract Vocals and Instrumental (2 Stems)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_task_status" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Check the status of a task started by process_audio." → after: "Check the status of a task. Just pass task_id. It auto-detects all generated tracks, MIDI, and chords."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
